## PR Review Summary: 5 draft comments kept, 0 dropped in validation (draft mode, nothing posted)

Almost all of the PR's ~115 replacements follow one rule: a colour that was `scale-color($primary, N%)` becomes `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, N%), scale-color($secondary, (100-N)%))`. That leaves light themes looking exactly as before. `dark-light-choose` (`common/foundation/variables.scss:46`) picks its first argument whenever `$primary` is darker than `$secondary`, which is every light theme. Five lines break that rule, so the PR changes how the default light theme looks.

### HIGH severity (0)

### MEDIUM severity (2)
- **`desktop/topic-post.scss:291`**: the `.topic-meta-data h5 a` username link was 30% and is now 70%/30%. The two values look swapped, so on light themes this bold link goes from dark gray to pale gray. It should be 30%/70%.
- **`mobile/modal.scss:102`**: the `.custom-message-length` hint text was 70% and is now 30%/70%, so the muted hint turns dark on light themes. The desktop version of the same rule was converted correctly to 70%/30%.

### LOW severity (3)
- **`mobile/topic-post.scss:182`**: `h3` was 20% and is now 50%/50%, which makes it look the same as `h4`. It should be 20%/80%; the 20% line at 247 in the same file was converted that way.
- **`desktop/user.scss:522`**: `.group-member-info .name` was 30% and is now 50%/50%. It now matches `.title`, so names no longer stand out from titles. It should be 30%/70%.
- **`mobile/user.scss:497`**: the same `.name` mistake as on desktop, with the same fix.

### Dropped in validation (0)
Separate validator agents checked all five drafts against the diff and the definition of `dark-light-choose`. All came back VALID.

The dark-theme values in the fixes (80% and 70%) follow the PR's own 100−N convention; they aren't values that existed before the PR.

Files are in `bench/runs/ai-code-review-evaluation_discourse-graphite-7/pr-proof/`:
- **`drafts_raw.json`**: the drafts as written, before validation.
- **`drafts.json`**: `{"kept": [5], "dropped": []}`, with each validator's verdict and evidence.

The repository was not modified, and there's no PR link because nothing was posted.
